role: secondary temporal site-template-resistant diagnostic; cannot replace or rescue the authoritative four-bay static TNC primary
delta_definition: paired_anchor_delta_tnc_42d = median across the three matched q25/q50/q75 anchor-specific changes (tnc_post_anchor - tnc_pre_anchor); tnc_post is the median of the same three post anchors
no_rescue: Do not drop tnc_post, baseline_frequency_post or water_body after inspection.
Do not widen the 39-45 day pre/post TNC interval after inspection.
Do not use this diagnostic to rescue a null authoritative four-bay static TNC primary.
Do not relax matched-anchor or TNC-QC requirements after future outcomes are inspected.
Do not interpret a pre/post contrast as trajectory if assay batch is perfectly confounded with sampling round.
Do not reinterpret an unsupported dynamic diagnostic as proof that reserve trajectory is irrelevant; its role is a bounded secondary test with moderate-to-large effect resolution.
Do not revert to difference-of-node-medians or choose an anchor subset after future outcome access; the paired-anchor median change is frozen.

measurement_validity_gate.method_pilot_prerequisite: Authoritative TNC-v2 response-independent method pilot must pass its frozen analytical QC before the dynamic diagnostic is eligible for ecological interpretation.
measurement_validity_gate.analytical_precision_boundary: Technical-duplicate median TNC CV <=10%, <=10% of duplicate pairs >15% CV, and all other frozen HPLC recovery/calibration criteria must pass under the authoritative method pilot.
node_level_requirements: exactly three frozen q25/q50/q75 anchor IDs per node
pre_anchor_tnc_qc_pass == true at all three anchors
post_anchor_tnc_qc_pass == true at all three anchors
same anchor IDs are paired across pre and post rounds
measurement_validity_gate.assay_batch_round_boundary: Pre/post round must not be perfectly confounded with HPLC assay batch. If all pre samples and all post samples are separated by batch in a way that makes round indistinguishable from batch, classify the dynamic diagnostic non-estimable.
measurement_validity_gate.interpretation: These gates reduce the chance that spatial core heterogeneity or analytical batch error is relabeled as reserve trajectory.
measurement_validity_gate.spatial_pairing_boundary: The node trajectory is computed from matched anchor-specific differences before node summarization. Do not compute delta as median(post anchors) - median(pre anchors), because that can relabel spatial core heterogeneity as temporal change.
measurement_validity_gate.paired_change_heterogeneity: Report sign/range of the three anchor-specific changes as descriptive measurement heterogeneity. Do not invent a concordance threshold after future outcome access to select favorable nodes.

design_resolution.planning_model_terms: delta_tnc_42d + tnc_post + baseline_frequency_post + two water-body indicators
design_resolution.approximation: Gaussian multiple-regression partial-correlation benchmark, two-sided alpha 0.05, 80% power; resolution warning only.
design_resolution.interpretation: The diagnostic is mainly capable of detecting moderate-to-large trajectory information beyond current reserve state. An interval overlapping zero does not establish that smaller trajectory dependence is absent.

measurement_error_boundary.issue: tnc_post and paired_anchor_delta_tnc_42d still share the post-exposure measurements, so measurement error in post TNC can induce correlated error in the state-versus-trajectory parameterization.
measurement_error_boundary.mitigation: Use the authoritative HPLC technical-QC gate, matched anchor neighborhoods, three independent spatial anchors, and report paired-anchor change heterogeneity. Do not hide or residualize measurement error post hoc.
measurement_error_boundary.interpretation: A supported trajectory coefficient is evidence that matched recent reserve change carries information beyond current reserve state; it is not proof of hysteresis, memory or causal depletion.
measurement_error_boundary.discrepancy_rule: If conclusions depend strongly on one anchor or fail under predeclared measurement-sensitivity checks, label the trajectory result measurement-sensitive rather than supported.
